issue.title: bob-mac-capture macOS CI red again since Go To commits fde8211/70c0839/5960b31: backslash insert helper, chip refetch, and error-prefix XCTests fail and swift test hits the 15-minute guard
issue.description:
bob-mac-capture master macOS CI went red again a few hours after `933091b`/`2884ea2`
restored it (run 41888215951 on `4906d94` was green end to end). Three Go To commits
landed without a lander: `fde8211` (backslash opens Go To), `70c0839` (synchronize Go To
scope snapshots), and `5960b31` (Command-X switches to completed tasks only). Their runs
41889511461, 41889993205, and 41900858873 all fail.

Failures in run 41900858873 (`5960b31`):

- `CaptureBackslashGotoTests.testInsertHelperDeclinesWhileComposingSubmittingOrLocked`
  (`CaptureBackslashGotoTests.swift:415`): `XCTAssertEqual failed: ("\") is not equal to ("")`.
  The insert helper leaves `\` in the draft when it should decline.
- `CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.testDelayedChipRefetchCannotReplaceReopenedSnapshot`
  (`CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.swift:487/493/501`): two "Condition not met before timeout"
  failures, then `Optional(1)` != `Optional(8)`.
- `CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.testFailureOnChipRefetchRetainsRowsAndReportsError`
  (`CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.swift:605`): the reported error is now prefixed with
  `bob command failed (exit 7): .../fake-bob capture-complete --all-tasks --closed-tasks ...`
  but the test expects the bare `controlled Go To fixture failure`.
- The Test step also hit the workflow's "swift test ran longer than 15 minutes; sampling
  xctest" guard. Use the uploaded xctest samples to find the hang.

Fix each root cause separately: product where the test reflects the intended contract,
and the test where the contract changed deliberately (for example the error-prefix
format). Do not delete or weaken tests. A green Test step is what lets Bundle, Launch
smoke, and Install run, so every Mac change ships unverified until this is fixed. Linux
hosts cannot run these tests, so verify on the exact-SHA macOS run (see bob-cli-1x).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The same assertions fail on three consecutive master SHAs (fde8211, 70c0839, 5960b31) after a fully green 4906d94; the error-prefix mismatch is a deterministic string difference.

issue.creation_reason: Mac master CI was green at 4906d94 and went red with three Go To commits that had no lander; the lead researcher of the research.3b bead-triage swarm found no bead or running agent that owns these failures.

payload.description: The process gap (pushing Mac code without watching macOS CI) that let these Go To failures land
Previous red Mac Test step, resolved by 933091b; verify-and-close it alongside this fix

evidence.note: Independent repro from the bob-cli-h2 lander: bob-mac-capture run 41931215313 on 10470e7 (h2.6 Record past work card) fails the Test step with the same CaptureBackslashGotoTests.testInsertHelperDeclinesWhileComposingSubmittingOrLocked, CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.testDelayedChipRefetchCannotReplaceReopenedSnapshot (487/493/501) and testFailureOnChipRefetchRetainsRowsAndReportsError (605, bob command failed (exit 7) prefix) assertions and hits the 15-minute swift test guard; Build passed and every Past suite (CapturePomodoroPastPresentationTests, CapturePastRefreshHostedTests, PomodoroPastDesignTests) passed, so the red Test step is not caused by h2.6.

Independent reproduction: bob-mac-capture master run 41937019961 on base SHA edb2f487c0ddf122961f8c6ae95f9c0d0df82038 and exact-SHA precommit run 41940043128 on snapshot SHA 9593ec6730a99c5b1e164d8ada7c878533c6fd53 both fail CaptureBackslashGotoTests.testInsertHelperDeclinesWhileComposingSubmittingOrLocked at line 415; the literal backslash remains instead of the empty string. The snapshot Swift lint and build pass, the Test step fails, and no hang sample was uploaded.

payload.description: Assess whether the repeated Mac CI failures on this integration are the same existing defect

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during the approved x= close-list change: base SHA d206803 run 42040970042 fails the same backslash insert helper, editor word-motion, partial-route comma, and separator-alias tests; exact snapshot a77fbb8 run 42052432463 repeats 13 of those failed cases. evidence.note: Proposed by bob-cli-ha.4 note #1; lander independently fetched and compared CI logs for phase snapshot 0f1ed3bf5db2338f002cba3ade78ed1de7ce4e02 (run 42037793376) and clean-base b2f3b61178661db5eeecd3ce7cf8bd70a510ac57 (run 42040643751). Both pass lint/Build and share 12 failing editor, backslash, comma-routing, and separator-alias tests, corroborating this existing report and its cl--1 evidence. The named-start-chain phase-only failure is excluded: the phase changed its parse fixture to x =de while test and fake-bob still use x =#de, and bob-cli-ha retains that integration repair. Base-only Move/Pull-In seed-count failure is already recorded in bob-cli-h8.5 note #1; two different trees are insufficient to label it a confirmed same-tree flake.

Proposed by bob-cli-h4.4 note #2 and bob-cli-h4.6 note #2; the h4 lander independently re-checked master: bob-mac-capture run 42079206476 on 6e09f2c (HEAD, h4.6 pending/refusal cards) fails only the Test step with 13 cases: CaptureBackslashGotoTests.testInsertHelperDeclinesWhileComposingSubmittingOrLocked, CaptureEditorWordMotionTests.testMotionsLeaveTextAndUndoUntouched, CapturePanelModelTests comma partial/exact route (2), and 9 CaptureSeparatorToggleTests alias/undo cases (now incl. testSlashAliasAfterTaskTypeOpensTypeMenuAndDoubleTapCloses from d206803). Same set on dd4a8bf (42027902336), d206803 (42040970042), 6c39ff8 (42058547878). No transfer presentation/card/landing/pending/refusal test fails; every Mac change still ships with a red Test step.

payload.entry: Corroborating CI flake evidence from the bob-cli-h4 tale's exact-snapshot gates (runs 42091249189, 42094381116, 42099437742 on bob-mac-capture snapshots whose product changes are transfer-only): three singleton failures, each observed once and passing in the other two runs — testMoveThenPullInBackAndInboxCarryOneAnswerAndSeed (seed count 2 vs 1), testSlowDoubleTapClosesMenuWithOneLiteralBackslash, testUndoAfterSlashAliasRestoresLiteralWithoutRetriggering (5s wait timeout). All are timing-sensitive suites; none touches transfer code.

evidence.note: Independently verified the macOS CI baseline before this plan on master SHA 9714a56d0d64aa3be2b2bcaf89977a349062604c: run 42089082999 fails the same 13 existing test cases listed in this evidence. This establishes those cases predate the relation dash implementation.

Independent report from bob-cli-he.4 (Mac Clip card phase, bob-mac-capture 9714a56), triaged by bob-cli-he.land: the macOS Test step hung at the 15-minute watchdog right after WorkBadgeToneTests on clean base 6e09f2c (run 42079206476) and on 9714a56 (run 42089082999); a re-run on 9714a56 (run 42092346376) instead failed 13 BobMacCaptureTests — CaptureSeparatorToggleTests x9, CapturePanelModelTests comma partial/exact route x2, CaptureBackslashGotoTests x1, CaptureEditorWordMotionTests x1 — and its stripped --log-failed error lines diff identical to the clean-base run. 9714a56 touches only CaptureModels/CaptureClipPresentation, clip fixtures/tests, and docs; all 12 CaptureClipPresentationTests pass on macOS. Several failures are 'Condition not met before timeout', consistent with a loaded runner.
